ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Inveigh Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Inveigh a cross-platform .NET IPv4/IPv6 machine-in-the-middle tool

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Inveigh\\\.exe$") OR (process_original_file_name = "\\Inveigh\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "\\Inveigh\.dll") OR process_description = "Inveigh" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-SpooferIP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ReplyToIPs\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ReplyToDomains\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ReplyToMACs\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-SnifferIP.*")))
